comment: Blocks cut from the OSM planet (osmium extract, simple strategy, bbox [west, south, east, north]) before the regions are cut from them (smart strategy). A block must also hold the large areas that reach beyond its regions (the egypt block covers the desert areas shared with Libya and Sudan). A region goes to the smallest block that contains the bbox of its outline (mapping/poly) widened by margin degrees. Each stream reads the planet once and writes its blocks; keep a stream at no more than 4 blocks (measured on planet-261116: 7.2 GB peak RAM for 3 blocks, about 2.4 GB per block, on a 16 GB runner).
